# gitmoap_repository_issue_settings (Resource)

Changes what the repository stores and returns it: only the fields you send change, a field sent as `null` is cleared so it is inherited again, and the stored values apply only while `override_group_settings` is on. A status set needs one unarchived open status marked as the default and at least one unarchived done status, and an existing status cannot change category — add a new status and archive the old one. Maintainers and above may do this; an empty body is refused.

The token needs `issue_settings:manage` and `issue_settings:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

# A repository's settings only take effect over its group's with override_group_settings.
resource "gitmoap_repository_issue_settings" "api" {
  repo_id                 = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
  override_group_settings = true
  default_issue_type      = "bug"
  public_issue_filing     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Optional

- `anchor_drift_action` (String) What happens when an anchored region of code changes beyond recognition.
- `auto_close_on_verified` (Boolean) Whether a work item closes as soon as it is verified. Defaults to `false`: passing criteria
make an item verified, and merging the merge request that closes it makes it done.
- `auto_reopen_on_orphaned_close` (Boolean) A closed item whose closing commit is in no branch any more reopens itself.
- `auto_reopen_on_regression` (Boolean)
- `binding_change_resets_evidence` (Boolean) Reset a criterion's evidence when its binding changes. Default **true**.
- `blocked_by_blocks_close` (Boolean)
- `close_on_commit_keyword` (Boolean)
- `closing_branches` (List of String) Branch globs whose commits close work items, in addition to the default branch, which always
does. Empty by default.
- `default_assignee_from_codeowners` (Boolean)
- `default_issue_type` (String) The kind of work item. The type decides where an item may live (a group or a repository), which
types it may have as children, and which fields it accepts.
- `override_group_settings` (Boolean)
- `public_issue_filing` (Boolean)
- `require_verified_criteria_to_close` (Boolean)
- `statuses` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--statuses))
- `todo_ignore_paths` (List of String) Path globs never scanned for TODO comments. Defaults to the usual locations of vendored
code.
- `todo_policy` (String) What a bare `// TODO:` in a push becomes.
- `todo_promote_type` (String) The kind of work item. The type decides where an item may live (a group or a repository), which
types it may have as children, and which fields it accepts.

<a id="nestedatt--statuses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `statuses`

Optional:

- `archived` (Boolean)
- `category` (String) The fixed category behind a status. A status also has a *name*, which the team owns and may
rename freely; the category is the part the platform reasons about. A team can call a status
"Ready for QA" and the platform still knows it is `in_review` — so a board can place it in a
column, a merge can move it, and a progress rollup can count it as not done.
- `color` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean) The status new issues land in. Exactly one status in a set carries it, and
it must be open.
- `name` (String)
- `status_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its repo_id.
terraform import gitmoap_repository_issue_settings.example "<repo_id>"
```
